name: remote-gosh
description: Work on a remote machine over gosh: the connection survives changing networks, sleep, and outages. Not independently reviewed.

commands.title: Choose Folders to Keep a Local Copy Of...
Keep a Local Copy of This Folder
Open the Folder of Local Copies

remoteGosh.goshVersion.description: The release of gosh to use. It is installed on this machine and on each host you connect to, from gosh's releases (tag vVERSION).

remoteGosh.releasesUrl.description: Where gosh releases are downloaded from, if not GitHub (each release is the directory vVERSION under it). The host you connect to downloads from here too.

remoteGosh.sshPath.description: The ssh program used to set up a connection. Empty means the one on your PATH.

remoteGosh.serverDownloadUrlTemplate.description: Where hosts download the editor's server from, if not the editor's own default. May use ${version}, ${release}, ${commit}, ${quality}, ${os} and ${arch}.

enumDescriptions: Terminals are the editor's own: they survive losing and regaining the connection, but end when the editor's server on the host does, some time after the editor is quit.

Terminals on the host attach to shpool sessions, which outlive the editor and can be reattached later, from the editor or any other login. If a Linux or macOS host has no shpool, the one that comes with this extension is installed there.
remoteGosh.persistentTerminals.description: Whether terminals on the host should outlive the editor. Takes effect the next time you connect.

enumDescriptions: Use UDP. If the host does not answer by UDP, carry the session over ssh until it does.
Carry the session over ssh from the start and do not use UDP. For a network known to block it.
remoteGosh.relay.description: What to do when the session's UDP cannot reach the host, as on a network that carries only TCP.

remoteGosh.localCopies.folder.description: Where on this machine copies of folders on hosts are kept. Empty means remote-gosh-copies in your home directory. Each is at HOST/path/on/the/host under it.

remoteGosh.localCopies.delete.description: Whether a file removed from a folder on the host is also removed from its copy on this machine. Takes effect the next time you connect.

remoteGosh.localCopies.interval.description: How often, in seconds, folders being copied are looked at for changes. Takes effect the next time you connect.
